hints.title: Share prefixes while exploring
hints.body: Several candidates may begin with the same letters. A trie lets one board search follow all of those candidates at once instead of restarting for each word.

hints.title: Search from every cell
hints.body: Treat each board cell as a possible first letter. Move to orthogonal neighbors only when the next trie edge matches the neighbor's letter.

hints.title: Mark the cell, then undo
hints.body: Before exploring neighbors, temporarily mark the current cell so the current word cannot reuse it. Restore the original letter after returning so other words can use that cell.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
build a trie of all candidates
found = empty set

visit(cell, node):
    letter = board[cell]
    next = child of node labeled letter
    if next is missing: return
    if next marks a word: add that word to found
    save = board[cell]
    board[cell] = '#'
    for each orthogonal neighbor inside the board and not '#':
        visit(neighbor, next)
    board[cell] = save

for every cell:
    visit(cell, root)
return sorted(found)
```
